text: {"features":[{"name":"Production lifecycle depth","description":"Extent to which the letter evidences sustained experience testing, maintaining, and launching production software systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only baseline qualifying experience, with a short tenure or narrow set of production services and little sense of mature responsibility."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows a few years of relevant production work but limited breadth in services, scope, or lifecycle ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid multi-year experience testing, maintaining, and launching several production services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial production depth across multiple services and clear comfort with the full software lifecycle."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows extensive, mature production experience that suggests strong judgment as both a maintainer and builder of services."}]},{"name":"Go proficiency","description":"Depth of evidence that the applicant can design and build back-end systems in Go.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"References Go as part of the background but gives no evidence beyond baseline production use."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Presents Go as a regular working language, but without showing major responsibility or system ownership in it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Makes clear that Go is a primary production language for the applicant."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Uses concrete examples to show Go as the primary language for back-end services or security-related systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows deep, central Go experience by tying it to architected back-end infrastructure or guardrail services closely aligned to the role."}]},{"name":"Python proficiency","description":"Depth of evidence that the applicant uses Python effectively in production tooling or services.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python or leaves Python ability effectively unsubstantiated."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python familiarity but gives little or no concrete production use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular Python use for scripts, tooling, or services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows extensive Python use across services, automation, or internal tooling with concrete examples."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows extensive, production-grade Python work with clear evidence of building maintainable services or automation that others rely on."}]},{"name":"Applied AI","description":"Strength of evidence that the applicant has built and deployed AI-backed functionality relevant to the role's AI components.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of hands-on AI work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI exposure or interest without showing deployment or real responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States hands-on work with model-backed or LLM-based features in production, but with limited depth."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows meaningful production AI experience and some attention to evaluation, reliability, or safeguards."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows substantial production AI experience with explicit evidence of careful evaluation, trustworthiness, or hardening for real-world use."}]},{"name":"Agentic architecture","description":"Strength of evidence that the applicant has designed systems in which agents act within explicit constraints or workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of designing agentic systems or autonomous workflows."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Alludes to automation or agents but without architectural detail or clear ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions building agentic pipelines or systems with identifiable components and responsibilities."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes end-to-end agentic architectures that pair agents with supervisory services or guardrails."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows deep agentic design ownership, including bounded autonomy, permissions, auditing, or similarly concrete control mechanisms."}]},{"name":"Security assessment practice","description":"Strength of evidence that the applicant can perform structured security reviews of systems or designs.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of actual security assessment work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Signals general security awareness but not concrete assessment practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions concrete assessment work such as threat modeling or code review, but only briefly."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows repeated hands-on assessment experience across designs or services with clear methods."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows mature assessment practice that treats reviews as engineering work with findings, follow-through, and remediation validation."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability triage automation","description":"Strength of evidence that the applicant has automated intake, triage, routing, or deduplication of vulnerability reports.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of having automated vulnerability handling."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in vulnerability response but does not describe prior automation work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions having built some tooling around vulnerability reports or queues."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes concrete automation of classification, routing, deduplication, or queue handling that reduced manual work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong ownership of an end-to-end vulnerability intake or triage pipeline with clear capacity gains for the team."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic problem solving","description":"Strength of evidence that the applicant applies data-structure and algorithmic thinking to real systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention data structures, algorithms, or similar problem-solving depth."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims algorithmic strength in generic terms without a concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives one credible example of improving a system through better data structures or algorithms."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives a clear, technically grounded example that materially improved performance, tractability, or correctness."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents algorithmic thinking as a clear strength, backed by especially strong or repeated examples of turning messy heuristics or bottlenecks into robust solutions."}]},{"name":"Reliability mindset","description":"How strongly the letter conveys an orientation toward dependable, maintainable systems and long-term operational quality.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows little evidence of concern for dependability, maintainability, or operational quality."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions rigor or quality in generic terms without an operational perspective."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows clear respect for maintenance, reliability, or the realities of inherited systems."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly emphasizes quiet resilience, maintainability, or high standards as important engineering values."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes dependable, higher-standard system building a central professional philosophy and links it directly to security tooling."}]},{"name":"Security automation insight","description":"How well the letter shows understanding of security automation as a leverage problem rather than just a coding task.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frames the role only in generic software terms and shows little understanding of security automation goals."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows broad interest in security automation but with shallow or formulaic reasoning."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly connects automation to reducing manual security work or scaling a security team."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows nuanced understanding of security bottlenecks, bounded automation, or capacity amplification."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows especially sharp insight into scaling scarce security judgment through mechanisms such as triage, variant analysis, or strong agent guardrails."}]},{"name":"Platform leverage","description":"How strongly the letter emphasizes building foundational systems whose benefits compound across many teams or products.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Focuses mainly on a generic job change with little sense of platform leverage."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Briefly mentions broader impact but does not make it an important theme."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly values foundational work that benefits more than one team or service."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Consistently frames past work and future goals around platform-level leverage and inherited improvements."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes platform leverage a central organizing idea and ties it convincingly to why this role is the right next step."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement","description":"How strongly the letter frames security work as helping product engineers do the secure thing by default.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows little or no awareness of serving developer users through the security work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions helping others in generic terms without a clear enablement mindset."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Expresses a clear desire to reduce friction or make secure practice easier for engineers."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly frames security tooling as developer support rather than policing, with concrete language about defaults or workflow fit."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows a deeply internalized secure-by-default enablement mindset, positioning low-friction tooling as central to both past work and future motivation."}]},{"name":"Security partnership","description":"How well the letter presents the applicant as ready to work closely with specialist security engineers.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no indication of interest in partnering with security specialists."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Provides only generic teamwork language without any security-specific collaboration angle."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States a clear interest in working with security engineers or learning from their craft."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows explicit respect for specialist security expertise and positions close partnership as important to the work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents collaboration with security experts as a core, credible part of how the applicant wants to operate in the role."}]},{"name":"Role tailoring","description":"How specifically the letter maps the applicant's background to this job's stated responsibilities and qualifications.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads largely generic and could fit many software roles with only minimal adjustment."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some awareness of the posting but addresses only a small subset of the role's key elements."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly matches several stated requirements or responsibilities to past experience."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Deliberately aligns the background to most of the role's major elements such as Go, Python, AI, security, and automation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Feels tightly tailored to this exact role and team, with a comprehensive and convincing match to the job's stated needs."}]},{"name":"Google-scale fit","description":"How convincingly the letter explains why Google's scale or environment specifically matters to the applicant.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Google only generically or not in a way that explains any unique fit."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Offers a generic positive statement about scale without linking it meaningfully to the work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Connects Google's scale to the value of security tooling in a plausible but standard way."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows clear excitement about Google's internal ecosystem, reach, or centrality and explains why that scale fits the applicant's goals."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes a persuasive case that Google's specific scale or leverage is uniquely motivating and unusually well matched to the applicant's strengths."}]},{"name":"Security motivation","description":"How compellingly the letter conveys a genuine desire to work on security-focused engineering rather than generic software development.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives little reason for wanting security work specifically."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States interest in security but mostly in generic or borrowed terms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives a plausible personal reason for wanting security engineering work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows clear and sustained motivation for security-focused infrastructure, resilience, or vulnerability work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Conveys a distinctive, credible security motivation that feels central to the applicant's professional direction."}]},{"name":"Ownership","description":"How strongly the letter shows the applicant as a driver who builds, redesigns, or takes responsibility rather than merely participating.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mostly describes interests or desired environments, with little evidence of personal initiative."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions some responsibility but mainly in a contributor role within others' work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows clear ownership of at least one tool, redesign, or project."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows repeated ownership of systems, automation, or architecture decisions."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a strong pattern of self-directed initiative, such as taking over neglected problems, designing from scratch, or maintaining substantial systems end to end."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"How concrete the letter's claims are, based on named systems, tasks, or technical examples rather than abstractions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on broad claims and adjectives with little concrete evidence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes a few concrete nouns or technologies, but most claims remain vague."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives at least a couple of specific examples that make the experience believable."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Uses several concrete, technically grounded examples across the letter."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is consistently evidence-rich, with specific systems, problems, and technical choices that make the applicant's fit easy to assess."}]},{"name":"Outcome focus","description":"How well the letter explains the results or impact of the applicant's work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Describes activities without indicating any result or value."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints that the work was useful but gives only vague or implied outcomes."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Connects some work to practical effects such as reduced manual effort, improved performance, or better reliability."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly ties examples to meaningful team or system outcomes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes outcomes central, showing clear operational or user impact from the work even when precise numbers are not given."}]},{"name":"Offensive security signal","description":"Strength of evidence that the applicant actively cultivates attacker-oriented security skills outside normal development work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of offensive-security practice or external validation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows only a light signal, such as casual interest, occasional practice, or a baseline security credential."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows ongoing practice through capture-the-flag participation or a clearly relevant security certification."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows a strong attacker-oriented signal, such as serious capture-the-flag involvement, OSCP, or similarly hands-on validation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows especially strong attacker-oriented evidence through both demanding validation and sustained practice, or through one of those at an unusually high level."}]},{"name":"Open-source engagement","description":"Strength of evidence that the applicant contributes to or maintains software used beyond their immediate team.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions no open-source activity."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions minimal open-source interaction, such as isolated patches or occasional fixes."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows recurring contributions or responsible upstream patching when issues are found."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Maintains an open-source project or library with active users or contributors."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows sustained open-source stewardship with reviews, releases, community interaction, or meaningful external adoption."}]},{"name":"Independent systems building","description":"Strength of evidence from personal projects that the applicant can build technically ambitious systems beyond assigned work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions no personal project or only a very small side build with little technical depth."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a modest side project with limited systems complexity."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a clearly technical personal project that goes beyond trivial application work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows an ambitious systems project involving distributed systems, reliability, recovery, or similarly hard engineering problems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows a substantial self-directed systems project built to confront difficult real-world concerns such as coordination, failover, consistency, or recovery."}]},{"name":"Narrative coherence","description":"How smoothly the letter develops a logical story about the applicant's background, interests, and fit.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Feels disjointed, list-like, or hard to follow as a unified application story."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has some logical structure, but transitions are abrupt or sections do not build on each other well."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Reads coherently overall, with a clear beginning, middle, and end."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Builds a strong throughline that links past experience, present motivation, and role fit."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Delivers a particularly well-shaped narrative in which each paragraph advances a unified and persuasive case for the application."}]},{"name":"Writing mechanics","description":"How polished the letter is at the sentence level, including spelling, grammar, and typographical accuracy.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent errors that noticeably distract from the application."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains several clear errors that weaken polish but do not obscure meaning."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Contains a small number of errors or awkward phrasings, yet remains professional overall."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is mostly clean and polished, with at most minor isolated slips."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is essentially error-free and professionally polished throughout."}]}]}
